title: Increase MATRIX_LR for faster transformer convergence
description: Increased MATRIX_LR from 0.04 to 0.06 to accelerate Muon optimizer learning rate for transformer matrices
reflection: Small but real improvement: val_bpb 0.996544 (baseline 0.996598, -0.000054). The modest 1.5× acceleration of transformer matrix parameter learning improved convergence within the fixed 5-minute budget. VRAM usage remained acceptable at 45GB. This validates the hypothesis that the Muon learning rate was slightly conservative for the time-constrained setting. Future rounds could explore whether other Muon hyperparameters (momentum, beta2) are similarly undershooting the ideal.
